{{BPFK}}

On March 15 2016, a vote by the BPFK membership was concluded<ref>https://groups.google.com/d/msg/bpfk-list/A8qyiW7Uod8/srh3RjOwDQAJ</ref> with a seven out of eight majority in favor of the following grammar change:

{{notci|A tense or tag attaches tightly to a following selbri unless explicitly terminated by {ku}. <br>
As a result, '''lo nu broda ba brode''' no longer parses as '''lo nu broda ba ku kei brode''' but now parses as '''lo nu broda kei ku ba brode'''.}}

The new rule is now officially part of BPFK Standard Lojban.
